sql: WITH home_losses AS (SELECT t.team_long_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses FROM "Match" AS m JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name) SELECT team_long_name, losses FROM home_losses WHERE losses = (SELECT MIN(losses) FROM home_losses);
